Introducing FocusVision 👁️ – an AI-powered real-time concentration tracker using just your webcam!
FocusVision 👁️ is a real-time concentration tracking system that helps users monitor their mental focus using just a webcam—no wearables or invasive tools required.
The system works by analyzing facial cues in real-time using computer vision. It tracks eye openness, gaze direction, head posture, blink rate, and even yawning, then interprets these signals to compute a live concentration score.
For example:
- Frequent blinking or closed eyes may indicate fatigue
- Gaze deviation and head turns may signal distraction
- Yawning triggers a warning of low alertness
- These signals are then mapped to live alerts and scores, offering a non- intrusive, intelligent assistant that keeps you aware of your focus level.
The core challenge addressed in this project was ensuring consistent accuracy across different faces, lighting conditions, and natural movements. Through user-specific calibration and smoothing techniques, the system now adapts to each person for better performance.
FocusVision is a step toward smarter, emotionally aware computing—perfect for students, remote workers, and anyone interested in mindful productivity.
I’d love to hear your thoughts on this project!
 Any suggestions for features or use cases are welcome. Let me know what you think in the comments!
